title: Secret in a framework or file context (ruby) — review required
description: A secret is embedded in a ruby context: secret_key_bases*=s*["'][^"']{4,}["']. Context-shaped secrets (framework keys, connection strings, config values) ship to checkouts and artifacts like any hardcoded value. This lexical rule flags the embedding; the reviewer confirms it is a placeholder or externalizes it.
remediation: Load the value from the environment or credentials store and rotate the embedded one.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches embedded values regardless of liveness. Generic secret assignments are separate rules.
